# Hangar

> Hangar is a self-hosted model and dataset hub, compatible with the Hugging Face Hub API, git, Ollama and LM Studio. huggingface_hub, the hf CLI, transformers, datasets, git and git-lfs, Ollama and LM Studio load files from it unchanged, and its web UI includes a Dataset Viewer. It is source-available under the Elastic License 2.0. It stores and serves model files; it does not run models.

Hangar pulls Repos from huggingface.co or another Hangar Instance, keeps their git history and Commit SHAs, and serves them from your own storage. Set `HF_ENDPOINT` to an Instance to use it in place of huggingface.co.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://hangar.page/latest/): what Hangar does, with a quickstart
- [Get started](https://hangar.page/latest/get-started/): install with Docker, Docker Compose, Helm or a binary
- [Point HF_ENDPOINT at Hangar](https://hangar.page/latest/get-started/hf-endpoint/): use Hangar in place of huggingface.co
- [Repos and Revisions](https://hangar.page/latest/concepts/repos/): how models and datasets are stored
- [Mirrors and Upstreams](https://hangar.page/latest/concepts/mirrors/): pulling from huggingface.co and other hubs
- [How Hangar compares](https://hangar.page/latest/concepts/comparison/): Hangar beside olah, JFrog Artifactory, Sonatype Nexus, CSGHub, MLflow and Hugging Face Enterprise
- [Ollama](https://hangar.page/latest/guides/ollama/): `ollama pull` GGUF models from Hangar
- [LM Studio](https://hangar.page/latest/guides/lm-studio/): install models into LM Studio from Hangar
- [Air-gapped Instances](https://hangar.page/latest/guides/air-gapped/): run Hangar with no internet access
- [Hub API compatibility](https://hangar.page/latest/reference/hub-api-compatibility/): every Hub API endpoint and whether Hangar serves it
- [Benchmarks](https://hangar.page/latest/benchmarks/): load test results for download latency and other scale targets
